title: Prosecution notes discrepancies in testimony on VP Duterte’s properties

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The testimonies of the witnesses presented by the defense lawyers of Vice President Sara Duterte showed discrepancies that suggest that certain properties were not declared in her statement of assets, liabilities, and net worth (SALNs). Former Rep. Ace Barbers, House prosecution adviser and spokesperson, pointed this out on Tuesday. He noted that two city assessors presented by the defense panel as its first witnesses failed to disprove any of the evidence presented by the prosecution regarding the undeclared properties of the vice president and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio.
